title: Amenmose
summary: Prince Amenmose, eldest son of Thutmose I, whom Scott identifies with Moses. His view. Not merged.
description: Added from the Dynasty of Slaves import. Display only. Scott’s synchronisms are his view. This chronology never sets a sort, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year (Dynasty of Slaves is display-only and never sets a sort).
